decisions.reason: A certified HVAC plate exchanger line close to the core offer carries low incremental cost, and with only one year of results there is no clear shortfall against aspirations to trigger search for other uses.
The marine box cooler line builds on established competences and serves a core customer segment, so the firm's slack lets it carry the line while results are still uncertain.
The marine cooling unit has its own dedicated page, signalling commitment, and there is no evidence of underperformance that would prompt problemistic search.
The compact oil cooler line fits the broad portfolio and the service-driven business model, and one year is too short to judge it below aspiration.
Finned tubes are a component technology that supports the air cooler business, so keeping them is cheap and helps the established offer.
Enhanced exchanger tubes reflect the firm's in-house R&D and its efficiency promise, and with no reported shortfall and adequate slack it keeps them.
